observed_text:
For planning removal, the supplied preparation guidance states that the removal procedure and sequence should first be studied using the machine plan (drawings) while considering the type of mounting fit, before any disassembly [EV-K01-011]. This is preparation guidance only; later page sections depend on bearing structure, access and fit and are not an unknown-machine procedure [EV-K01-011]. No, this teaching material cannot select a removal force or a heating temperature for the unidentified equipment: the card explicitly provides no tool specifications, removal force or heating parameters [EV-K01-011]. The caller-assigned class 'inner_race' and the scenario assumption of shaft/housing misalignment during mounting are teaching inputs, not observations or classifier inferences, and cannot be used to infer actual damage cause, reuse or aircraft release. The NSK flaking example (angular-contact ball-bearing inner ring, diagonal raceway flaking attributed to mounting-time shaft/housing misalignment) is a manufacturer example only and cannot diagnose the project sample; other flaking causes exist [EV-I01-001].

Evidence limitations:
Removal guidance is generic bearing education only; no tool specifications, removal force or heating parameters are supplied [EV-K01-011].
The NSK flaking example is a reported manufacturer example for an angular-contact ball bearing; it does not establish flaking, misalignment or causation in the project sample, and no alignment limits, repair or release rules are given [EV-I01-001].
No actual device records, model-specific thresholds, or aviation/reuse authorization were supplied; the class label and scenario assumption are teaching inputs, not evidence of actual condition.
Source applicability is generic bearing education only, with no transfer validation to CWRU artificial defects or aviation equipment [EV-K01-011][EV-I01-001].
Sources:

EV-I01-001
